svg.title: The roadmap
svg.desc: A winding map of twenty stations across five regions: foundations, data, the workshop, infrastructure, and the frontier. Agentic systems is in hand; Cloud and DevOps are the next targets; observability, system design, security, MLOps, Rust, and distributed systems lie beyond.

path.aria-label: A direction of travel, kept honest.
11 walked · 1 in hand · 2 next · 6 on the horizon
